# Marin Agricultural Land Trust

> MALT preserves farmland and protects Marin County's agricultural heritage through conservation easements, stewardship programs, and policy advocacy.

The Marin Agricultural Land Trust (MALT) has been working since 1980 to protect farmland and support sustainable agriculture in Marin County, California. The organization combines land conservation, farmer support services, and advocacy on critical issues like agricultural worker housing and water resources.

## Key Topics

- Conservation easements
- Farmland protection
- Agricultural stewardship
- Marin County
- Climate resilience

## Core Conservation Programs

- [Farmland Protection](https://malt.org/farmland-protection): MALT's primary service preserving farmland and protecting the local foodshed in Marin County through conservation easements.
- [Farmland Stewardship](https://malt.org/farmland-stewardship): Technical assistance and sustainable agriculture support programs helping farmers implement conservation practices.
- [Grants Program](https://malt.org/grants-program): Grants and stewardship assistance initiatives including drought resilience and climate-smart agriculture projects.
- [Where We Work](https://malt.org/where-we-work): Interactive map showcasing MALT's protected farms and conservation easements across Marin County.

## Organization & Strategy

- [Mission & History](https://malt.org/mission-history): MALT's founding mission, vision, and organizational history since 1980 in Marin County.
- [Our Conservation Strategy](https://malt.org/our-strategy): MALT's 2025-2030 strategic framework organizing conservation work around five core pillars.
- [Equity, Inclusion, & Justice](https://malt.org/equity): MALT's commitment to social and racial justice in conservation work and organizational practices.
- [Our Native Land Acknowledgment](https://malt.org/native-land): MALT's acknowledgment of Coast Miwok indigenous peoples and their historical land stewardship.

## Advocacy & Policy

- [Active Issues](https://malt.org/active-issues): MALT's advocacy positions on climate-smart agriculture, water resources, and agricultural policy.
- [Agricultural Worker Housing Crisis](https://malt.org/active-issues/housing): MALT's advocacy on affordable housing solutions for agricultural workers in Marin County.
- [Marin Water Reservoir Expansion](https://malt.org/active-issues/marin-water-reservoir-expansion): MALT's policy position on water infrastructure development and farmland preservation.

## News & Impact

- [Blog](https://malt.org/blog): Stories covering MALT's conservation work, farmer profiles, and agricultural stewardship achievements.
- [Newsletters](https://malt.org/newsletters): Newsletter publications and impact reports highlighting MALT's conservation milestones and program updates.

## Connect & Support

- [Contact Us](https://malt.org/contact-us): Contact information and office location in Point Reyes Station, California.
- [Story Ideas for Media](https://malt.org/story-ideas): Media outreach resources for journalists covering agricultural conservation and stewardship in Marin County.
